assets.prompt: Create a completely new original 3D modeling reference sheet from this object name alone: TREASURE CHEST (宝箱). Use case: stylized-concept. Intended deliverable: a high-quality stylized game-ready 3D prop for a playful film-making game. Invent a coherent, beautifully crafted adventure treasure chest with an arched lid, well-proportioned solid wood body, warm dark walnut planks, restrained aged iron or antique brass reinforcement, authentic hinge axes, substantial central hasp and keyhole, inset side carrying rings, four short feet and believable joinery. It should read immediately as a treasure chest at gameplay distance. Rich geometry and material clarity, elegant primary masses, purposeful secondary construction details and selective handling wear, not primitive box assembly, not excessive ornament. Build a reference sheet for an actual modeler: one large three-quarter colored hero render plus clearly separated orthographic FRONT, SIDE, and BACK views of the exact same design, all doors/lid closed. Rear hinges, side rings, plank seams, lid curvature and thickness must be explicit and mechanically coherent across all views. At the bottom include a small wood/brass/iron material study. Consistent proportions, no inconsistent extra parts between views. Neutral warm gray studio background, soft clear lighting that shows form. The object is a closed hand-carried chest, no treasure contents or surrounding scenery. No logos, no watermark, no branding. Freely author the design based on the name; do not reference or preserve any earlier image, model, color palette or proportions. Polished stylized PBR visual target with a crafted game art finish.
assets.source: Object name and textual design brief only; no input images.

assets.prompt: Create a completely new original 3D modeling reference sheet from this object name alone: RETRO REFRIGERATOR (レトロ冷蔵庫). Use case: stylized-concept. Neutral warm gray studio background, soft clear lighting. No food, characters, surroundings, logos, readable branding or watermark. Author the design freely based on the name, not on any earlier image or existing model; do not preserve an earlier color palette or proportions. Polished stylized PBR visual target, high-quality crafted game art.
